title: keycloak: add plugin, updates, and support for Unix socket auth
reason: Applicable: real keycloak module + wired test (keycloak = discoverTests (import ./keycloak.nix);). Real diff changes useSSL's own default EXPRESSION (adds a new `&& !hasPrefix "/" cfg.database.host` conjunct) and passwordFile's type (path -> nullOr path, default null).
targets_toml: single target keycloak, cfg_ident=cfg, option_prefix=[services,keycloak,database] (useSSL is declared inside the database={} submodule, not directly under services.keycloak -- confirmed by reading the real file structure before targeting, first attempt with option_prefix=[services,keycloak] alone also returned OptionNotFound, corrected), watch=[useSSL].

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: 5th instance of the wastebin-class candidate_capability_gap. discovered_options is COMPLETELY EMPTY for this file even with the corrected option_prefix. Confirmed cause: keycloak.nix declares its own top-level options via `options.services.keycloak =` (line 80, dotted-path form), same idiom as wastebin/paretosecurity/sanoid. Tally now: wastebin/B3, paretosecurity/B6, sanoid+keycloak/this batch = 4 confirmed instances.
